messages:
maria: FYI I'm kicking off a small canary for v2.3.0 tonight. Need a coordinated lease handoff for console and router (stateful), plus runtime pin + warmup. Target window 21:45-22:30 UTC.

aj: what weight for the canary? and do we need a slow ramp?

maria: start 3% then 5% after 10m if metrics look good. router+console get the canary weight; runtime gets pinned with dry-warm so KV warms before cutover.

sanjay: note: router must keep header-split fallback to v2.2.9 rule "hdr-fallback-2.2.9" and ensure cookie steering is in place for canary ids. I'll validate routing rules before traffic shift.

maria: good call. @deploy-bot create leases at 21:40 UTC with 30m TTL for console+router and return lease ids.

deploy-bot: running: `deploy-bot lease create --svc console --ttl 30m --owner maria`
deploy-bot: created lease console-lease-99bA
deploy-bot: running: `deploy-bot lease create --svc router --ttl 30m --owner maria`
deploy-bot: created lease router-lease-99bB

felix: I'll be on-call during the window. If we see >2% error-rate increase on p50, I want to hold traffic and check logs.

ops-bot: Heads-up: by policy some noisy alerts will be muted for scheduled canary windows. Critical alerts (CPU OOM, disk IO) remain unmuted.

jess: I'll mute the non-critical alerts and add a dashboard filter for canary ids. Also posting a short release blurb to #release-notes: "v2.3.0: routing header tweak, console UX fix, runtime perf improvement".

aj: pin commands to use? want to avoid full cutover typo.

maria: use explicit canary flag: `deploy-bot pin --svc router --ver v2.3.0 --mode canary --weight 3 --meta canary=eu-2100` then `--weight 5` after validation. runtime: `deploy-bot pin --svc runtime --ver v2.3.0 --mode dry-warm` console: same canary pin as router.

deploy-bot: executing preflight smoke: images present, healthchecks pass, canary quota ok.
deploy-bot: smoke ok for console, router, runtime.

aj: starting runtime warmup: kicking off 100 synthetic KV preloads. progress: 25%

sanjay: validating hdr-fallback-2.2.9 rule now. found rule present but TTL on the fallback cookie was 0. Need it set to 1h for testing; updating.

maria: go ahead. also set leases to extend automatically if no rollback after 25m.

deploy-bot: updating router-fallback cookie TTL to 1h... ok.

deploy-bot: scheduling lease autorenew at minute 25.

maria: cutting traffic to 3% at 21:50 UTC. watch p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and console error streams.

ops-bot: muted alerts: routing-trace-noise, console-ui-flapping. keeping pages for: svc-oom, sustained-5xx, infra-network-failure.

jess: dashboards set. alert mute active. watchlist created: pin-9001, canary-eu-2100.

deploy-bot: pin commands executed:
```
deploy-bot pin --svc router --ver v2.3.0 --mode canary --weight 3 --meta canary=eu-2100
deploy-bot pin --svc runtime --ver v2.3.0 --mode dry-warm
deploy-bot pin --svc console --ver v2.3.0 --mode canary --weight 3 --meta canary=eu-2100
```
deploy-bot: router pin ok (pin-id: pin-9001)
deploy-bot: runtime pin ok (pin-id: pin-9002)
deploy-bot: console pin ok (pin-id: pin-9003)

aj: runtime warmup ~60% now. KV hitrate climbing.

sanjay: initial metrics at 5m: p50 +4ms, p95 +20ms, 5xx delta +0.3% (within threshold). no spike.

maria: thumbs up. plan to move to 5% at +10m. keep leases and don't extend until 25m unless stable.

felix: continuing log tailing. no new error classes.

maria: moving weight to 5% now.

deploy-bot: updating router+console weights to 5%... ok. (pin-9001 updated)

jess: dashboard reflects 5% canary. alerting still muted for noisy channels.

sanjay: verifying fallback path by forcing a header mismatch in staging traffic tests — fallback succeeds, traffic routed to v2.2.9 for affected keys.

aj: runtime warmup complete. KV primed.

maria: good. hold for 20m then decide rollforward/rollback. rollback window until 22:30 UTC. If we need to rollback: commands are `deploy-bot pin --svc <svc> --version v2.2.9 --mode emergency` and revoke leases.

ops-bot: reminder: if we rollback, please unmute alerts after revocation so SRE sees any issues.

maria: noted. thanks all. I'll post a short runbook in #release-ops and update the canary tags in the console.

felix: I'll keep watching until end of window. ping me if you want manual hold.

maria: closing the loop: so far healthy. will post final status at 22:28 UTC. :rocket:
